title: Snapshot and ranking: up is a 1-5 dimension; publish {mean, n, hist, upShare}; no net in items.json or proposals
description:
Repo: **Papyrus**. Files: `src/papyrus_content/reader_steering/snapshot.py` (`UP`, the up/down/net block at ~line 216 `votes_summary`-style function, `rating_summary`, `weighted_reader_means`, `distinct_raters`, the items.json assembly ~line 589), `src/papyrus_content/reader_steering/proposal_votes.py` (`partition_votes` ~108, `needs_a_look` ~147-159 counting `value == 1`), `src/papyrus_content/reader_steering/ranking.py` (no formula change; add `up_share` helper), `src/papyrus_content/reader_steering/snapshot_test.py`, `proposal_votes_test.py`, `features_backend/reader-subject-votes.feature`, `features_backend/reader-steering.feature`, `docs/score-combination.md` (one paragraph: the `up` dimension is a 1-5 dimension like the others).

## Change
Treat `up` as a rating dimension everywhere a snapshot reads votes, always on stored values 1-5 (this story reads only post-migration values; the migration story backfills).
- Per subject and dimension, publish `{mean, n, hist, upShare}`: `mean` rounded to `SCORE_DECIMALS` (None when n = 0), `n` the count, `hist[i]` the number of `i+1` ratings, `upShare` = (hist[3] + hist[4]) / n rounded to 4 decimals (None when n = 0). Keep the `new_account_weight` weighting for `mean` exactly as `weighted_reader_means` does today; `n` and `hist` are plain counts.
- `items.json`: replace `{up, down, net, score}` with `{up: {mean, n, hist, upShare}}` under the subject's `dimensions` block, the same shape as the other dimensions. Rising and the hype gap read `hist[3] + hist[4]` where they used to count upvotes. No `net` anywhere.
- Proposals: `partition_votes` and `needs_a_look` count a stored value >= 4 as up and <= 2 as down (3 is neither); the public proposal counts become `{mean, n, upShare}`.
- Shrinkage: `up` joins the dimension means fed to `shrinkage_front_score` only when the site lists it in `dimensions` (opt-in, no change in ranking for sites that do not); document that in `docs/score-combination.md`.
- Privacy scan unchanged: still counts, means and histograms only.

## Gherkin
  Scenario: The snapshot publishes mean, count, histogram and up share for the up dimension
  Scenario: Four and five are counted as up, one and two as down, three as neither
  Scenario: A new account's judgement weighs less in the mean but counts once in the histogram
  Scenario: Items.json holds no net score
  Scenario: The proposals data publishes a share of up judgements instead of a net
  Scenario: A site that lists up among its dimensions ranks with it and one that does not is unchanged
  Scenario: The public files never identify a reader

## Acceptance
`poetry run pytest src/papyrus_content/reader_steering`; backend cucumber; `grep -rn '"net"' src/papyrus_content/reader_steering` returns nothing. Blocked by the write-path story (same stored values). Shipped's `shipped-proposals.js` reads the new shape in the Shipped-web story (Shipped session).
